description: Lists subscriber attributes (custom keys set on subscribers via the JS SDK) on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`). Use this to discover attribute `key` values before constructing an audience-group filter rule with field="attributes".

key_contains.description: Optional substring filter on the attribute `key`. Maps to API `key_like`. Use this when looking up an attribute by name (e.g. searching for "plan" to find the "plan" attribute key).

limit.description: How many attributes to return in this page. Min 1, max 100, default 10. To browse past the first 100, increase `page` instead of asking for a larger limit.

page.description: Page number (1-indexed) for paginating beyond the first batch.

name: pushengage_list_attributes
title: List subscriber attributes
